description: Make a barcode image on white, with quiet zones and the readable text under a 1-D code, and get a 24-hour download link. type is code128 (printable ASCII, up to 48 characters), ean13 (12 digits, or 13 with a check digit that must match), upca (11 digits, or 12 with a check digit that must match) or qr (up to 300 characters). format is png (default) or svg. Returns url, expires_at and text, what a reader will decode (including the check digit). Free within a daily quota counted in documents (see start.md). Make receipts only for lawful purposes, such as replacing a lost receipt, bookkeeping, testing or design mockups. Using a receipt to deceive anyone, including for refunds, expense claims or proof of purchase, is prohibited.
name: make_barcode
